# Microsoft Visual C++ x64 Redistributable

Original Microsoft installer, redistributed without modification. The installer contains the Microsoft license terms. Source and exact SHA256 are recorded in VC_redist.source.json. The bootstrap also verifies the Microsoft Authenticode signature before installation.

Official information: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist
License terms: https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/license-terms/vs2022-cruntime/

The runtime is optional when the bundled applications already run. Installation may require Windows administrator consent and does not disable antivirus or install forensic mounting drivers.
